components.name: Admin Rail
components.description: Navy rail; active item fills navy-700 with a gold bar and gold icon.
components.html: EventsLot DrawCompanies
components.css: .ds-rail { width: 264px; padding: 10px 0; background: #0b2240; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rail-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; margin: 2px 10px; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #d6deea; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); color: #fff; } .ds-rail-item.is-active { background: #1b3f70; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-rail-item.is-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -10px; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 3px; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; background: #e3a92b; } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #ffdd00, 0 0 0 5px #0b0c0c; }

components.name: Draw-Stage Stepper
components.description: The signature: four stops on every draw, passed ones filled, the current one ringed.
components.html:
1. Draft
  2. Open
  3. Closed
  4. End
components.css: .ds-stepper { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; width: 420px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stepper li { position: relative; flex: 1 1 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-stepper li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 9px; left: calc(-50% + 12px); right: calc(50% + 12px); height: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: #dce1e8; } .ds-stepper li:first-child::before { display: none; } .ds-stepper .dot { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 20px; height: 20px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #fff; border: 2px solid #c3ccd8; color: transparent; } .ds-stepper .label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: #586477; } .ds-stepper li.done::before, .ds-stepper li.current::before { background: #1a56db; } .ds-stepper li.done .dot { background: #1a56db; border-color: #1a56db; color: #fff; } .ds-stepper li.done .label { color: #344054; } .ds-stepper li.current .dot { border-color: #1a56db; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #ebf1fd; } .ds-stepper li.current .dot::after { content: ''; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1a56db; } .ds-stepper li.current .label { color: #101828; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-stepper li.current .dot { animation: ds-stop-in 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both; } @keyframes ds-stop-in { from { box-shadow: 0 0 0 12px rgba(26,86,219,0); } to { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #ebf1fd; } } }

narrative.overview:
undilot reads like a government service and works like a well-made dashboard: a navy shell that holds still, white work surfaces on a cool grey ground, one blue that acts. The office sits at a desk for hours scanning draw lists, so its screens are dense, Stripe-calm tables and forms at 40px controls. Usahawan, many older and on a phone, get the same world at a larger size: one reading column (760px), 1rem body, 48px targets, one large button per draw.

Nothing is decorative. Depth is a hairline and a whisper of shadow; colour carries meaning (blue acts, gold marks what is yours, state colours always name themselves in words). The one authored moment is the draw-stage stepper's current stop settling in. The system refuses the grey dashboard with a single accent and the frosted Apple imitation it replaced.

The whole thing ships with no build step: every stylesheet is an inline <style> in a Blade partial, and the only libraries (Bootstrap 5.3.3, Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3) come from a CDN with pinned versions and SRI hashes. Tokens live once, as --ui-* custom properties in partials/ui-tokens.blade.php; nothing else should spell a hex value.
keyCharacteristics: Navy shell (rail, app bar, sign-in panel), white surfaces on a cool grey ground.
One action blue; Kraftangan gold only for "yours", "you are here" and the mark.
GOV.UK yellow-and-black focus ring on every focusable thing.
System UI type with tabular figures on every number.
Hairline borders, 12px card corners, 8px control corners.
The draw-stage stepper on every draw, office and portal alike.
Two component prefixes that never meet: .mac- for the office, .ap- for usahawan.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Only blue acts. A secondary action is white with a strong hairline; a destructive action is white with bad-text until hover turns it solid bad.

rules.name: The Gold Means Yours Rule
rules.body: Gold marks the usahawan's lot, where you are in the nav, and the mark. It is never a button fill, a status, or a highlight for anything else.

rules.name: The No Stray Hex Rule
rules.body: Colour comes from --ui-* tokens. The legacy --mac-*, --ap-*, --adm-*, --apple-* and --pub-* names survive only as aliases onto --ui-* so old inline styles resolve; new code uses --ui-* directly.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every table cell, time, draw meta line, lot code and count sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, so columns of numbers line up when scanned.

rules.name: The Bigger For Usahawan Rule
rules.body: The portal sets every equivalent role one step larger than admin, and its text-size toggle scales the root to 112% / 126%. The office gets the same toggle at 112% / 124%.

rules.name: The Tables Become Cards Rule
rules.body: Below 768px every .mac-table stacks: each row a bordered 12px card, each cell a label/value line whose label is copied from the column header by script (cells with a form control, colspan, or a blank header are skipped). The outer card gives up its chrome so cards never nest in cards.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: A surface is separated from the ground by a 1px border, not by shadow. Never stack a shadow heavier than Rest on anything that does not float.

dos: Do take every colour, radius, shadow and duration from --ui-* in partials/ui-tokens.blade.php.
Do write styles inline in a Blade partial and load libraries from a pinned CDN URL; there is no build step and no Node in production.
Do use .mac- classes on office pages and .ap- classes on participant pages, and only one of the two on any page.
Do give every focusable element the GOV.UK ring (0 0 0 3px #ffdd00, 0 0 0 5px #0b0c0c); plain text links take the yellow highlighter with a black underline instead.
Do show status as a word with its marker, never as colour alone.
Do put the draw-stage stepper on every draw, full on a draw's own page and compact in a table row.
Do keep portal targets at 48px and text at 1rem or more.
donts: Don't use gold for anything except the usahawan's lot, the active-nav marker and the mark.
Don't introduce a second action colour; blue is the only one that acts.
Don't put .mac- or .ap- classes on the sign-in views; they carry their own look.
Don't spell a hex value in a view; the leftover Apple-era greys in older views are drift, not precedent.
Don't add a shadow heavier than Rest to anything that does not float.
Don't suppress the focus ring or replace it with a blue glow for keyboard users.
